boot_hello.title: SYSLOG 0x01
lines: CORE OFFLINE. GRID IN SAFE MODE.
KEY FRAGMENTS SCATTERED ACROSS SECTORS.
BRING THEM HOME. MIND THE GAPS.

help_zap.title: HELP ZAP.EXE
lines: FIRES A FAST BOLT THE WAY YOU FACE.
SHORT COOLDOWN, 10 ENERGY A SHOT.
HITS ENEMIES AND SWITCHES TARGETS ON/OFF.
TIP: A HIT ALERTS THE TARGET. AIM FIRST.

help_shield.title: HELP SHIELD.EXE
lines: WRAPS YOU IN A CRACKLING RING FOR 7 SEC.
BLOCKS INCOMING BOLTS, ARCS AND BURSTS.
DOES NOT STOP A BITE. KEEP YOUR DISTANCE.

help_firewall.title: HELP FIREWALL.EXE
lines: A RING OF FLAMES AROUND YOU FOR 7 SEC.
BLOCKS BOLTS, BURSTS AND TOUCH ALIKE.
BURNS ANY ENEMY THAT PRESSES CLOSE.
COSTS 40 ENERGY. WORTH EVERY BYTE.

help_pause.title: HELP PAUSE.EXE
lines: A BOLT THAT FREEZES AN ENEMY FOR 5 SEC.
FROZEN PROCESSES ARE HARMLESS AND SOLID:
STAND ON THEM, PARK THEM ON A PLATE.
STILL HITTABLE. RESUMES WHEN TIME RUNS OUT.

help_blink.title: HELP BLINK.EXE
lines: DASHES UP TO 3 UNITS AHEAD IN A FLASH,
OVER GAPS, HAZARDS AND HOLES.
HURTS ANY ENEMY YOU DASH THROUGH.
WARNING: A WALL IN THE WAY HURTS YOU.

help_warp.title: HELP WARP.EXE
lines: TELEPORTS YOU AHEAD, AS FAR AS THE FIRST
WALL OR OBJECT IN LINE. ANY GAP, ANY WIDTH.
SAFE LANDING, SHORT OF WHAT STOPS YOU.
COSTS 30 ENERGY.

help_cut_paste.title: HELP CUT_PASTE.EXE
lines: CAST: CUT THE CRATE OR FROZEN ENEMY
IN FRONT OF YOU INTO YOUR CLIPBOARD.
CAST AGAIN: PASTE IT INTO THE FREE CELL
IN FRONT OF YOU. PASTING IS FREE.
THE CLIPBOARD TRAVELS WITH YOU.
NOTHING ON TOP, YOUR LEVEL ONLY.

help_compile.title: HELP COMPILE.EXE
lines: BUILDS A CRATE IN THE FREE CELL AHEAD.
A STEP UP, OR A PLUG FOR A HOLE.
PUSH IT, PULL IT, STAND ON IT.
IT DEREZZES AFTER 7 SEC. WATCH THE BLINK.

help_fork.title: HELP FORK.EXE
lines: SPAWNS A HOLOGRAM OF YOU IN THE FREE CELL
AHEAD. IT STANDS FOR 10 SEC.
IT HOLDS A FLOOR PLATE DOWN.
ENEMIES THAT SEE IT GO FOR IT, NOT YOU.
A NEW FORK REPLACES THE OLD ONE.

help_scan.title: HELP SCAN.EXE
lines: SENDS A WAVE 6 UNITS OUT FROM YOUR FEET.
FAKE BLOCKS IT REACHES DEREZ.
HIDDEN EXITS IT REACHES OPEN UP.
SOMETHING LOOKS OFF? SCAN IT.

help_pull.title: HELP PULL.EXE
lines: PULLS THE FIRST CRATE OR ENEMY IN LINE,
UP TO 6 CELLS AWAY, ONE CELL TOWARD YOU.
ENEMIES GO EVEN INTO A HOLE.
PULLED ENEMIES BLAME YOU. BE READY.

help_zap_plus.title: HELP ZAP+.EXE
lines: PATCH FOR ZAP. SAME KEY, SAME COST.
BOLTS NOW BOUNCE OFF WALLS 3 TIMES.
BANK A SHOT ROUND A CORNER,
OR INTO A TARGET OUT OF PLAIN SIGHT.

help_shield_plus.title: HELP SHIELD+.EXE
lines: PATCH FOR SHIELD. SAME KEY, SAME COST.
ENEMY BOLTS NO LONGER JUST FIZZLE:
THEY FLY BACK THE WAY THEY CAME, AS YOURS.
LET THE SENTINELS SHOOT THEMSELVES.

help_double_jump.title: HELP DOUBLE_JUMP.SYS
lines: PRESS JUMP AGAIN IN MID-AIR
FOR A SECOND JUMP.
REACHES 2 BLOCKS UP AND WIDER GAPS.
OLD ROOMS MAY HIDE NEW WAYS. GO BACK.

help_fragments.title: FRAGMENT.DAT // BOOT KEY
lines: GOLD TILE: 1 OF 64 MODULES OF THE BOOT KEY.
KEY GRID IS 8X8. HUD MAPS EACH SHARD ON PICKUP.
RECOVERED SHARDS PERSIST ACROSS CRASHES.
DELIVER TO CORE TO RAISE ACCESS LEVEL.

help_core.title: HELP CORE.SYS
lines: THE CENTRAL CORE READS YOUR FRAGMENTS.
TOUCH IT TO RAISE YOUR ACCESS LEVEL.
BRING ALL 64 AND THE GRID REBOOTS.
COME BACK WHENEVER YOUR KEY GROWS.

help_access.title: HELP ACCESS.LVL
lines: DOORS MARKED I, II OR III ARE LOCKED
TO LOW ACCESS LEVELS.
CORE GRANTS: 16 FRAGMENTS  -> LEVEL I
32 FRAGMENTS  -> LEVEL II
48 FRAGMENTS  -> LEVEL III
A GOLD BAND ON YOUR HAT FOR EACH LEVEL.

access_1.title: ACCESS DENIED
lines: THIS SECTOR NEEDS ACCESS LEVEL I.
BRING 16 FRAGMENTS TO THE CORE.

access_2.title: ACCESS DENIED
lines: THIS SECTOR NEEDS ACCESS LEVEL II.
BRING 32 FRAGMENTS TO THE CORE.

access_3.title: ACCESS DENIED
lines: THIS SECTOR NEEDS ACCESS LEVEL III.
BRING 48 FRAGMENTS TO THE CORE.

tut_move.title: BOOT.LOG // 0x02
lines: KERNEL SPAWNED USER PROCESS: WIZARD.EXE
INPUT DRIVERS: WASD, ARROWS, SPACE (JUMP).
STEP LIMIT: ONE BLOCK. TALLER IS A WALL.
UNHANDLED EXCEPTION: RESTORE FROM SHRINE.

tut_push.title: MEMDUMP // CRATE.DAT
lines: CRATE: MOVABLE ALLOCATION. LIME. 1X1X1.
FORCE ON A FACE: IT SLIDES ONE CELL.
NULL SECTOR IN FLOOR TABLE, 2 CELLS WIDE.
FILL WITH ALLOCATIONS. 2 CRATES ON FILE.
FALL INTO NULL: PROCESS RESTARTED.

tut_zap.title: PORTMAP // ZAP.EXE
lines: DATA DISK ON HOST: ZAP.EXE. INSTALLS ON CONTACT.
INVOKE: E. CYCLE LOADED PROGRAMS: TAB / Q.
TARGET NODES TOGGLE ON BOLT IMPACT.
NORTH DOOR: POWERED BY ONE TARGET NODE.
BUG.PROC PATROLS THE PORT. BITE: -1 INTEGRITY.

tut_atrium.title: DIR // /HOME/LATTICE/ATRIUM
lines: HUB NODE. WINGS MOUNT HERE AS ACCESS GROWS.
ALLOCATIONS ARE STRUCTURE: A CRATE IS A STEP.
STEP LIMIT 1 + CRATE 1 = REACHABLE HEIGHT 2.
